A QUICK TOUR

Your book. A clearer path.

  1. Pick a unit and a page. Page numbers refer to the Student’s Book, not the larger numbers on the Teacher’s Guide photographs.
  2. Try first, then reveal. Open individual answers, or use “Show all” and “Hide all” for the current page.
  3. Make the samples your own. The peach “Sample answer” label means one possible response. Other relevant, correct answers are valid.
  4. Keep your place. Save pages or mark them reviewed. These choices are stored only in this browser.
  5. Take it to class. “Print unit” includes every page and answer in that unit.

Based on the supplied MEB Grade 11 Teacher’s Guide photographs. Fixed answers follow the guide; short model answers are original teaching examples. Audio and video answers use the printed keys and transcripts. Media files and appendix exercises were not supplied. This is an independent resource, not an official MEB publication.
